text:
Ava (Sales): FYI — Zenith Health POC call 9am PT tomorrow. They want reserved GPUs + burst for demo and need the security questionnaire answered by EOD today. Looking for a capacity + pricing sketch we can send after the call. Thoughts on a proposal?
Jules (Solutions Eng): quick question — what's their expected traffic profile (steady vs burst) and sequence lengths?
Ava (Sales): they gave roughs: steady ~300 qps, short spikes to ~1200 qps for 2–4 minutes, avg input ~512 tokens. Model they want to validate = open-llama-70B (4-bit quant). Latency SLO for demo: ~300ms p50.
Dmitri (Infra): rough perf note: q70B@4bit on A100-ish => expect ~10–20 rps per GPU at 512 tokens depending on batching. For 1200 qps peak we'd need ~60–120 effective GPU-rps -> translates to ~6–12 GPUs depending on batching + KV cache hit.
Jules (Solutions Eng): ok. I'd propose two options to present:
- Option A (Conservative commit): 6 reserved A100s, autoscale policy to +4 burst GPUs for traffic surges (can go to 10 total). Prefilled batching and prefix cache tuned for conversation workloads.
- Option B (Lean commit + aggressive burst): 4 reserved A100s + burst credits to scale to 12 for short spikes, with guardrails (max burst window 5m, cooldown 10m).
Ava (Sales): which option better for latency predictability during demo?
Jules (Solutions Eng): Option A more predictable for p50/p95, Option B cheaper committed spend but reliance on burst capacity increases p95 variability. If we need <300ms p50 and reasonable p95, pick A.
Priya (Security): Zenith is asking about SOC2, SSO (SAML), KMS/HSM key control, and 1 year audit log retention. Do they require Private (VPC) deployment or is hosted with VPC peering enough?
Ava (Sales): they flagged "private control plane" as strongly preferred, but open to discussion if we can meet KMS + strict IAM + audit logs on hosted.
Dmitri (Infra): we can do hosted with customer-managed KMS + VPC peering + 1yr log retention. If legal insists on an air-gapped instance, that's Private deployment and adds setup lead time (2–4 weeks).
Carlos (AE): need ballpark pricing delta for the two options to put in the proposal. Tina, can you give quick monthly cost ranges for reserved A100s + burst credits?
Tina (Finance): ballpark monthly committed list (examples): reserved A100-equivalent = $18k–$25k / GPU / month depending on term. Burst credits (on-demand) ~3x reserved unit cost per GPU-hour. For proposal I'd give:
- Option A (6 reserved + burst to 10): commit cost ~6 * $20k = $120k / mo baseline; expected average monthly overage risk low.
- Option B (4 reserved + burst to 12): commit cost ~4 * $20k = $80k / mo; plan for ~50–150 GPU-hours of burst per month -> add ~$5k–$20k variable.
Also include one-time private deployment setup if required: estimate $25k–$60k depending on on-prem vs VPC Private control plane.
Ava (Sales): great. Can someone draft the exact autoscale policy text we can paste into the proposal? Need cooldowns, max-burst window, fallback model mapping.
Jules (Solutions Eng): draft below — feel free to copy/paste:
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_capacity: 6
  burst_capacity_max: 10
  burst_window_max: 5m
  burst_cooldown: 10m
  target_latency_p50: 200ms
  fallback_sequence:
    - model: q70B-4bit
      priority: 1
    - model: q13B-8bit
      priority: 2
  kv_cache: enabled
  batching: dynamic (max_batch_size=64)
```
Dmitri (Infra): + add routing policy: route to private cluster if tenant is on Private plan, otherwise hosted with KMS. Also include policy to circuit-break to smaller model at p95 > 1s.
Priya (Security): I'll start filling Zenith's security questionnaire. Quick asks to confirm: can we provide (1) SOC2 report (yes), (2) SAML SSO + SCIM (yes via our enterprise tier), (3) customer-managed KMS + HSM attestation (yes for Private; hosted supports KMS integration but HSM attestation is Private-only), (4) audit log retention controls (we can set 1yr retention), (5) data deletion SLA (30 days).
Ava (Sales): perfect — I'll log that in the questionnaire. One more sales ask: can we guarantee no model weights exported and a contractual clause around that?
Priya (Security): we can add contractual language for weights export prohibition and data processing addendum. Private deployments have additional protections.
Carlos (AE): I'll tell the customer we'll send 2 pricing options + security answers + autoscale policy. Jules, can you attach latency perf numbers for 4 vs 6 vs 10 GPUs so they can see expected p50/p95?
Jules (Solutions Eng): will run a short perf matrix tonight and paste results here.
ops-bot: Scheduled load test job #zt-2219 queued by Jules. ETA results ~6h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jules (Solutions Eng): quick note — for the perf matrix I'll test: 4,6,8,10 GPUs; batch sizes 8/16/32; measure p50/p95 for 512 token inputs. If p95 > 1s on Option B under peak we'll call out fallback to q13B with expected quality delta.
Tina (Finance): I'll prepare a compact pricing sheet with clear committed vs burst cost examples for the AE pack.
Ava (Sales): thanks everyone — plan: 1) send option A/B + autoscale policy + security answers after perf numbers, 2) call tomorrow 9am PT to align, 3) if they want Private we prep SOW and lead times. I'll follow up with the questionnaire draft in ~2h.
Jules (Solutions Eng): copy that. Will post perf results in thread when ready.
Dmitri (Infra): ping if you want me to sketch infra diagram for Private vs Hosted.
Priya (Security): I'll attach the initial answers to the questionnaire and the legal language for weights export.
Ava (Sales): awesome — closing thread until perf numbers in. :thumbsup:
